description: Scala source file defining utility functions for handling MLlib vectors and arrays within Apache Spark's MLlib module.

methods.name: vector_to_array
methods.description: Converts a column of MLlib sparse/dense vectors into a column of dense arrays.

methods.name: array_to_vector
methods.description: Converts a column of array of numeric type into a column of dense vectors in MLlib.

methods.name: array_binary_search
methods.description: Performs binary search on an array column, used internally.

methods.name: vector_get
methods.description: Retrieves an element from a vector column at a specified index, handling dense and sparse vectors.

methods.name: array_argmax
methods.description: Finds the index of the maximum value in an array column.
